items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 7 at 12:24PM PDT until September 9 at 12:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 3 to 6 ft at 7 seconds and north winds 15 to 20 kt
with gusts up to 25 kt expected.

* WHERE...Inner Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence
out 10 NM, and Waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR from 10 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 2 PM Tuesday to midnight PDT Tuesday night.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
